## What was written

**`src/test/org/apache/commons/lang/EntitiesAgentTest.java`** — the only file created.

- **Style match**: JUnit 3 idiom used by the ~35 sibling tests (`extends TestCase`, `junit.framework.*`, `(String name)` constructor, `public static Test suite()`, `assertEquals`/`assertNull`/`fail`). Runs cleanly under the `org.junit.runner.JUnitCore` verifier. Source is kept strictly ASCII (non-ASCII chars written as `\uXXXX`) so it doesn't depend on the compiler's source encoding.

- **Public API covered**: the three prebuilt instances (`XML`, `HTML32`, `HTML40`), `addEntity`, `addEntities`, `entityName`, `entityValue`, `escape(String)`, `escape(Writer,String)`, `unescape(String)`, `unescape(Writer,String)`.

- **Assertions on values/state**, e.g. exact escaped strings (`"<hello>&"'"`), exact `Writer` contents, entity code points, `-1`/`null` sentinels, and round-trip equality.

- **Boundary & error cases**:
  - Entity-set membership differences (XML has `apos` but not `copy`/`euro`; HTML32 has ISO-8859-1 but not `apos`/`euro`; HTML40 has `euro`/`Alpha`).
  - Lookup-table boundary at code point 255/256; values below/above 0x7F for escaping.
  - Numeric-entity overflow (`&#12345678901234567890;`, `&#999999999999;`, `�`, `𐇐` all left verbatim) — the same failure mode as the project's own `testNumberOverflow` trigger.
  - Malformed input: `&amp` (no semicolon), `&&` (`&…&…;`), `&#;`, `&;`, unknown entity names, empty/ampersand-free strings.
  - `NumberFormatException` from `addEntities` with a non-numeric value; `NullPointerException` from null `String`/array args; `IOException` propagation from a failing `Writer`.
  - Per-instance isolation (custom entities on one `Entities` don't leak to another).
